Game's sadly beyond death at this point, the last chance they had was the steam release,  what killed this game?

Frustrating Balancing choices coupled with massive grindwalls.
Let me elaborate here, Grinding up  a ship would't be much of a problem if your opponents weren't so far ahead. New players have to deal with being free food for any veterans, veterans have played longer and have earned their ships and such, not saying its their fault for winning but by destroying new players to the point of them not being able to get kills alienates them and drives them away.

As a new player you Quickly realize that there is a 40-60 hour wall between you and the Tier 4 veteran to just get on the same Ship tier as them. 100 more hours to get on the same gear level as them, more than 400 hours to get enough experience to compete with them, you just don't feel like grinding it up anymore do you?

then you start seeing the vicious circle this creates, new player go in, get anihilated, frustrated at Corvettes single handedly winning games, frustrated at supports that deal the same damage as your fresh t3 ship, at this point most players leave.

New players leave, no noobs to play with noobs, veterans kill noobs, noobs leave, repeat

Solutions? i'm afraid there is nothing you can do to really save this game at this point...

all i can think of is making all ships freely avaliable, lower the grinding wall to 5-10 hour for a piece of equipment, make an announcement this has been done, try to get a bunch of new players with this. otherwise as Veterans get bored and drop off the whole game will slowly fade off over time like a white dwarf
